chunks: So which of the favours of your Lord will you deny?
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the refrain 'Fabi-ayyi ala'i rabbikuma tukadhdhiban' in Surah Ar-Rahman?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the dual pronoun 'kumā' is often interpreted as addressing both the Jinn and humans, or alternatively the angels and humans, emphasizing universal accountability. This refrain underscores the concept of 'tadbir' (divine management) by linking specific blessings to their source, urging believers to recognize Allah's grace in both worldly and spiritual realms. It serves as a poignant reminder of the covenant of alast, where creation acknowledges its Lord amidst the abundance of favors.
